_comment: Six values for the 10, 13, 17, 22, 28, 37 mm spheres; null where no limit applies. Contrast limits (>=) refer to the sphere types of 'standard' ("2012": 10-22 mm hot, 28/37 mm cold; "2018": all hot) unless 'sphere_types' is given, e.g. ["hot","hot","hot","hot","cold","cold"]. BV limits are <=, lung limit is <= (null = no limit). Load via Acceptance limits > Load limits JSON.
